**Nexo v0.4 beta 5** adds roles and stops Nexo from losing your account. Nexo updates itself: look for
the **Restart to update** banner.

> **Hosts:** update your server **before** your friends update Nexo. With Nexo Server: stop it, run
> `nexo-server update`, start it again. The oldest account on your server becomes its **owner**;
> `nexo-server owner <name>` changes that.

## What's new

- **Roles.** Every server now has an **owner** (the host), **admins** and **members**. Only the owner and
  admins can create, rename or delete channels, and they can delete anyone's message. Everyone else chats,
  talks and shares as before. The owner picks admins in **Settings → Members**, where the owner and admins
  can also remove accounts.
- **Nexo no longer forgets who you are.** Some of you were sent back to the "pick a name" screen after an
  update and ended up as a new user. Nexo now keeps a backup of your login. It also finds your login
  when the host's address changes, and it tells you when something goes wrong.
- **Welcome back.** If your login is lost anyway (new install, cleared data), Nexo recognizes your PC when
  you connect through Tailscale and offers **Continue** with your old account: same name, picture and
  messages.
- **"This is my account".** Joining with a name that's taken, on a new PC or without Tailscale? Click
  **This is my account** and an admin gets an **Approve / Deny** banner. Once approved, you're in your old
  account.

## Install

Already on v0.2.0-alpha.1 or later? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself.

On a **test build** (v0.4.0-test.x)? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart
Nexo. Test builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
